what: When several sections stuck (sticky) at screen height stack one after another, each section comes into focus while its own box passes the screen (view timeline cover 0→100%), from 20px blur · 1.1× · transparent to sharp at the 22% point. From 40% to 65% it shrinks to .95× and fades out, so as the next section rises and covers it, the previous one sinks back. look: early comes into focus at 18% and fades out from 33% to 45% (first section), while look: stay does not fade out and only shrinks to .95× by 65% (last section). No curve, tied straight to scroll.
